kernel_bug_found_and_fixed: First full harness run failed 2 legacy-DB tests (test_connect_migrates_legacy_db_before_optional_column_indexes, test_connect_heals_reduced_tasks_schema_seeded_by_external_harness) with sqlite3.OperationalError 'no such column: project_id': the new idx_tasks_project had been added to SCHEMA_SQL, but executescript parses each statement against the live schema, so the index over the additive tasks.project_id column aborted init on legacy boards before the ALTER TABLE pass. Fix: index moved out of SCHEMA_SQL into _migrate_add_optional_columns (kanban_db_connect.py) — the rule the migration itself documents for idx_tasks_tenant/idx_tasks_session_id. Fix proven targeted (both failing files green, NO_LEFTOVERS), then the COMPLETE harness re-run green.
reproof: second full harness run on the fixed kernel: all green (506 existing + 19 new + E2E)

notes: Board-first governance: the shared board DB holds goal rows (kanban_project_goals, PK board+project_id) and rollups; the per-profile projects.db stays a read-through registry (never written). Tenant is a validated-at-write, soft-filtered-at-read namespace, not an isolation wall. Budget writes go through hermes_cli.kanban_cost set_budget/remove_budget (the one budget write path) AFTER the goal-row commit — both sides idempotent, crash between them self-heals on next call. No N+1: every rollup number comes from one aggregate SQL statement over idx_tasks_project. Worker runs (run 157) exhausted its 100-iteration budget mid-harness; run 158 re-verified everything from scratch, found and fixed the SCHEMA_SQL index bug, and re-proved the full matrix green.
